pool.text: Diego Velazquez de Cuellar founded the seventh village of Santiago de Cuba.
The settlement was destroyed by fire and was immediately rebuilt.
Santiago became the capital of the Spanish colony of Cuba.
The first cathedral was built in the city of Santiago de Cuba.
French forces plundered the city of Santiago de Cuba.
English forces plundered the city of Santiago de Cuba.
English forces raided Santiago de Cuba under Christopher Myngs.
The Haitian slave revolt started before refugees arrived in Santiago.
Eighteen thousand refugees came to Santiago from Saint-Domingue.
Haiti declared its independence as a republic.
French citizens were ordered out of Cuba after Napoleon's forces invaded Spain.
Facundo Bacardi Masso started the world-famous Bacardi brand in Santiago.
Spanish troops suffered a major defeat at San Juan Hill.
Sampson destroyed the Spanish Atlantic fleet just outside Santiago's harbor.
Fidel Castro led rebels in an armed attack on the Moncada Barracks.
Pais's organization merged with Castro's 26 July Movement.
Fidel Castro proclaimed the victory of the Cuban Revolution from city hall.
The Baconao Park was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage Biosphere Reserve List.
